diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed before change that only the external1<->web1 path was degraded: public validation showed 33.3333% packet loss and 7146.192 ms average RTT from external1 to 10.10.40.10, while other lab connectivity checks passed. Read external1 state/config and found eth1 up with qdisc netem applied, implicating a leftover impairment on the affected path. Removed the root qdisc on external1 eth1 via update_object(qos delete_root). Re-validation passed the full public success criteria: lab connectivity passed, and external1->web1 measured 0% packet loss with 0.287 ms average RTT.
diagnosis.reference: On external1, egress traffic on interface eth1 toward web1 (10.10.40.10) is delayed by 3565 ms by a traffic-control (netem) queueing discipline.
